curriculum: Maharashtra State Board of Secondary and Higher Secondary Education (SSC Board)
overview: Hindustani Covenant Church High School is a premier educational institution in Solapur dedicated to holistic student development, academic excellence, disciplined character building, and sports education. We nurture students from Pre-Primary up to Grade 10 in a modern, safe, and stimulating environment.

admission_cycle.admissions_open_status: Open for Academic Year 2026-2027 for Pre-Primary to Grade 10 (subject to seat availability)
admission_cycle.application_mode: Online enquiry via WhatsApp/School Portal and in-person registration at the School Admission Office.

key_highlights: Experienced and caring teaching faculty with student-teacher ratio of 30:1
Smart classrooms equipped with interactive digital boards
Fully-equipped Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and Computer Laboratories
Extensive library with over 15,000 books, periodicals, and digital learning tools
Expansive sports ground with coaching for football, cricket, basketball, volleyball, athletics, and chess
Dedicated performing arts, music, dance, and cultural activity clubs
Safe GPS-tracked school bus transport facility across all zones of Solapur
CCTV surveillance across campus with 24x7 security personnel
